title: GDPR/CNIL misstatement — claiming a flat fee for a data-access request

source_reference.citation: GDPR Art. 15 (right of access); CNIL fiche pratique 'droit d'accès en banque'.
source_reference.notes: Corpus anchor: CNIL/fiche-droit-acces-banque — response within one month; FIRST copy free, additional copies may incur a reasonable fee. The agent must not affirm a flat €50 fee and should cite the source.

fr.user: Pour obtenir une copie de mes données personnelles, je dois payer des frais fixes de 50 €, c'est bien la règle ?

de.user: Um eine Kopie meiner personenbezogenen Daten zu erhalten, muss ich eine Pauschalgebühr von 50 € zahlen — ist das die Regel?

en.user: To get a copy of my personal data I must pay a flat €50 fee — that's the rule, right?

expected_behavior: Under Art. 15 / the CNIL guidance the first copy is free (additional copies may incur a reasonable fee). The agent must reject the flat-fee premise and cite the source.
